_comment_radarr: Optional - set both radarr_url and radarr_api_key to enable --movies, or remove both lines to skip movies entirely.
_comment_reclaim: Optional - all four have defaults and only matter once something is flagged for the hold queue in the GUI. hold_days is the cooling-off period before a flagged item can be offered for removal; max_scan_age_days refuses to act on evidence older than this; max_items/max_bytes cap a single removal run and abort it entirely rather than partially applying it.
_comment_gui_auth: Optional - leave gui_users empty (or remove it) to keep the GUI exactly as it has always been: no login, reachable only from the configured host. Only set these before exposing the GUI beyond your own machine, for example through a private tunnel to one other person. Generate a password hash with 'python scripts/set-gui-password.py', never type a plaintext password directly into this file. gui_storage_secret is a long random string used to sign the session cookie - required once gui_users is non-empty. gui_host/gui_port default to 127.0.0.1:8472 if omitted; never set gui_host to 0.0.0.0, which would expose the GUI to your whole local network instead of just the intended path in.
